{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue distribution again carefully
print("Revenue distribution:")
print(sales['revenue'].describe())

# Count how many orders have zero revenue
zero_revenue = sales[sales['revenue'] == 0].shape[0]
total_orders = sales.shape[0]
print(f"\nNumber of orders with zero revenue: {zero_revenue} / {total_orders}")

# Check if these zero-revenue orders are all 'completed'
zero_revenue_completed = sales[(sales['revenue'] == 0) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')].shape[0]
print(f"Number of zero-revenue orders that are completed: {zero_revenue_completed}")

# Check if there's any pattern in the order_id that might suggest test orders
print("First 10 order_ids:")
print(sales['order_id'].head(10).values)

# Check the 'converted' column for zero-revenue orders
print("Converted status of zero-revenue orders:")
print(sales[sales['revenue'] == 0]['converted'].value_counts())"}
